mcp_tool.description: The MCP tool of this backend the AI Agent uses to query what the widget shows: a server named in this backend's apps.json mcpServers, and the tool

raw.description: The endpoint also answers `raw=true` with the rows the widget shows, as JSON: the AI Agent and MCP get those rows, and the widget's rows button shows them

data.description: How Workspace reads and shows the data of this type

allOf.description: Body params are sent only with "method": "POST"
A widget kept from the Copilot (disableRetrievalForCopilot) cannot opt in to an MCP tool
theme and raw: query params the FINOS Workspace adds to this type's requests
data.rawDataKey and data.rawType describe the rows of raw=true: they need "raw": true

PluginConfig_test_chart.description: The settings of the widget that handles this type, from the settings schema of its plugin; a widget keeps them at storage.plugin.config
